annotations.title: Write a script, hooks or a translation

description: Writes an ad script from a product or a web page, or, given a saved script, writes alternative opening hooks for it or translates it, and returns a job whose result holds the script. Spends a few of the account's credits only with a held quote. Without one, returns the cost and makes nothing. Give product or page_url to write a new script; give script with hooks (how many) or with translate_to (a language) to work on one.

angle.description: The angle or hook to take.

brand.description: The id of a saved brand whose voice to follow.

hooks.description: With script: how many alternative openings to write.

language.description: The language to write in (default English).

offer.description: The offer or call to action.

page_url.description: A web page to read the product from, instead of product.

product.description: What is being sold, in a sentence or two.

quote.description: The held quote for this exact request, after the person confirms its cost.

script.description: The id of a saved script to work on, from an earlier ugcfans_write_script.

seconds.description: How long the ad runs, 5 to 120 (default 30).

translate_to.description: With script: the language to translate it into.

name: ugcfans_write_script
title: Write a script, hooks or a translation
